**Test build for Nexo 1.3.2**: your own accent color, and the app icon now reaches the taskbar. Everyone else
stays on v1.3.1.

> **Hosts:** no server update needed; servers on v1.3.0 or later work with this build.

## New

- **Custom accent color:** in **Settings → Appearance → Accent**, the last swatch opens a color picker. Pick
  any color or type its hex code. Nexo makes it a little lighter in dark themes or darker in the light theme
  when it would be hard to read. The Accent and Paper app icons use it too.

## Fixes

- **App icon on the taskbar:** the icon you pick in **Settings → Appearance → App icon** now also changes
  Nexo's Start menu, desktop and taskbar shortcuts. The taskbar shows it the next time you start Nexo.
- **Title bar:** the logo in the top-left corner now shows the app icon you picked.
- **Accent swatches:** the Mint swatch showed the color of whatever accent was selected.

## What to test

- Pick an app icon, quit Nexo from the tray and start it again: does the taskbar show the new icon? And the
  Start menu and desktop shortcuts? If you pinned Nexo to the taskbar, does the pin change too?
- Try a few custom colors in the dark and light themes: do buttons, links and highlights still read well?

## Leaving test builds

Already on a test build? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself. To go back to the regular releases:
**Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo.
